date_note: DHC announced the leak on November 18, which is the date used; the sources do not give the date of the intrusion into PLAID's KARTE.
title: DHC: about 19.11 million customer records leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: DHC announced on November 18 that about 19.11 million online-shop customer records leaked after unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE marketing service. NHK, Kyodo and Yomiuri report names, email addresses and dates of birth; Kyodo and Yomiuri say credit card payment data was not included, and Yomiuri says no misuse has been confirmed.
plain: Japanese cosmetics firm DHC says the data of about 19 million customers leaked through a hacked marketing platform.
exec: One of the largest Japanese consumer-data leaks of the year, through a vendor rather than the company itself.
action: DHC customers: treat unexpected emails or texts using your name and birth date as phishing; change reused passwords.

validation.note: NHK, Kyodo and Yomiuri agree on the figure and cause; DHC's own notice not opened.

review.note: NHK, Kyodo, Yomiuri confirm 19.11M, names/emails/DOB, card data excluded, no misuse; removed unsupported claims on shop passwords and PLAID Nov 13/16 dates; correction filed
